questions.subject: PHYSICS_EM
questions.learningObjective: State energy basis of Lenz law
questions.stem: Explain why Lenz law's opposition rule is required for energy conservation in an induction design.

answer.exemplar: If the induced current aided the change instead of opposing it, the increasing flux would drive more current, which would further increase the flux in a runaway loop that creates energy from nothing. Opposition ensures work must be done against the induced field to change the flux, conserving energy.

questions.explanation: Aiding would create positive feedback and free energy. Opposition means external work is needed to change flux, conserving energy.
